skills.name: motion-infographic
skills.description: Build a flat 2D animated LinkedIn infographic on Canvas 2D, exported as a 1080 x 1350 still, MP4 and GIF. Two starters: feed (phone-readable steps, stats, counters, bars, icon badges) and map (a dense system-map poster with stages, icon cards, logo chips, connectors, decisions and dot matrices), both with a build-in in reading order and a seamless loop. Use for any animated infographic, GIF or motion graphic for a post or lead magnet; 3D scenes go to diorama-3d, static stills and carousels to graphics-designer.
